Alex C.: Heads-up — I'm proposing an RBAC change for incident key access during escalations. Want to run a tabletop and get signoff.
Priya N.: +1. What exactly are you proposing? more granular roles or temporary elevation window?
Alex C.: Both. Sketch: create two new roles `hsm_incident_readonly` and `hsm_incident_emergency`, ephemeral 1h OTP elevation for the latter. Also a log-only service account that mirrors reads to external audit-sink.
Theo W.: Can you paste the minimal policy snippet? need to check constraints with the HSM proxy.
Alex C.: Sure — sample IAM snippet:
```
allow: principals: [role:hsm_incident_emergency]
actions: [hsm:getKeyMaterial, hsm:exportAuditTokens]
conditions: {ephemeral: true, max_duration: 3600}
```
Priya N.: Love the ephemeral condition. We also need to ensure KMS-integrations (customer CMKs) respect split custody: emergency role should not allow key transfer out of HSM boundary.
Alex C.: Agreed — add deny: key_export unless escrow-approved.
Theo W.: Two concerns: 1) audit trail integrity when we mirror to external sink (S3). We need signed append-only logs. 2) service-account creds must be short-lived and tied to the same OTP flow.
Alex C.: For (1) thinking of writing a signed merkle-chained file per incident session, store root in internal KMS — and we emit hash to external sink. For (2) yes, use STS token with duration=15m, rotated by central token broker.
sec-bot: Incident policy change detected for `hsm_incident_emergency`. Automated checklist: create PR, run sim, notify legal/compliance. Link: https://ci.internal/pr/4221 :robot_face:
Morgan: Quick ops question — will this affect existing BYOK customers? we must preserve their audit controls and not create any silent reads.
Priya N.: It must be opt-in for BYOK customers. Default remains: customer-managed key operations require explicit customer consent and audit export toggle. We'll need to update onboarding docs.
Theo W.: Vulnerability triage note: if the OTP broker is compromised, attacker could escalate within 15m. Add detection rule to block concurrent sessions from same principal across regions.
Alex C.: Good call — add rule and alert to oncall runbook. Also propose a tabletop next Friday 10am PT to walk through flows; will invite infra, compliance, and SEs.
Morgan: I'm in. Also suggest we produce a short decision memo for sales/ps so they can tell customers what changes mean.
Priya N.: I'll draft the compliance note and the onboarding checkbox text. Alex — can you open the PR and reference this thread?
Alex C.: Will do. PR will include the policy, merkle-chaining proof-of-concept, and the detection rules. Linking here when created.
